changelog: Floating Window & Agy Call UI: added depth shadows, crisp gradient edge borders, and compact icon buttons (Aspect Ratio, Max, Open, Min, Close) in FloatingChatActivity.

Automation Upgrade (android_automation_mcp): direct YouTube Music watch URI resolution for modified YT Music builds, AudioManager playback verification, package_name/url parameter aliases, and semantic-first UI instructions.
Foreground Service Fix: AntiGemService notification now counts running chat sessions alongside terminal sessions.
Merged upstream standalone updates and preserved all F2.0.5 features (jev_mcp, 1-shot assistant, NotificationListener, Discord dark theme, and debug update checks).
